## 55312177dae6

**Reproduced validator/authority defect.** The advertised `texture=no_match` path is part of the declared generator domain and returns three nonmatching shapes. `self_check` returns `[]`, but the selected Racket authority has no repeated rotational form to select and errors (`map: expected list?, given #f`). The source-bound reproducer records the exact generator/rule hashes, seed, override, input, validator verdict, supported `arcpuzzles apply` command, and authority error at `checks/audit-repro/55312177dae6/counterexample.json`; the raw authority receipt is `racket_no_match.json`.

The validator is broader still: the retained defect-lint run confirmed acceptance of all-background, full-one-color, short-line, singleton, and solid-2×2 impostors in every sampled probe (`checks/audits/55312177dae6-defect_lint/checks/55312177dae6_before_defect_lint.log`). It also confirmed that all three advertised negative textures pass `self_check` and that all four helpful textures are dead. The rare final `return g` fallback can therefore return a partially placed scene without the validator enforcing the repeated-rotation/distractor invariant. Standalone self-check happened to pass its default sample, so this is specifically a validator-power and advertised-negative-domain failure, not evidence that every default draw is broken. Lint also fails because `RULE_HASH` is absent (`checks/audits/55312177dae6-lint/`). No fix was made because this was an audit-only target.

triage.reason: Retained both adversarial findings and reproducers in their target indexes; unrelated target source remains unchanged.
